status: Source and numerical checks passed; native visual and performance acceptance pending
problem: Only boundary heights were stitched. Normals and slope-derived materials used each tile's own derivative spacing; intermediate fine vertices did not reproduce coarse-edge attributes. The vertex shader also normalized these intermediate normals before interpolation.
change: Use the coarse boundary's complete float surface attributes and derivative radius. Carry sparse point constraints at corners and T-junctions, including diagonally incident coarse tiles. Normalize lighting normals after raster interpolation. Physical terrain function and terrain resolution are unchanged.
limits: Does not replace triangular cliff geometry. Cliff rock geometry is a separate follow-up. Conservative water-root exclusion channel13 intentionally remains grid-dependent and is not asserted as a colour/material attribute.
research_application: Geometry and shading need matching transitions into a coarser level; stitching positions alone is insufficient. This implementation uses the existing CPU-generated worker mesh and adds no render pass or per-frame terrain sampling.
